Retrieve the associated active ingredients recommended by the MEDI-C database for the identified ICD-10 code.

Provide the scientific rationale, pharmacological class, mechanism of action, and reference dosage for the recommended active ingredients (e.g., SSRIs like fluoxetine, stimulants like methylphenidate).
